# ShaadiSunnah (Sunnah Safar)

> ShaadiSunnah (also known as Sunnah Safar) is a Muslim matrimony platform for Nikah, based in India. It is built around family involvement and privacy: every profile is reviewed by the team before it goes live, photos and names are blurred for visitors who are not logged in, and mobile/WhatsApp numbers are shared only after both people accept an interest. The platform is for adults (18+) looking for marriage, not for casual chat.

## Key facts
- Name: ShaadiSunnah (Sunnah Safar). Website: https://shaadisunnah.com
- Service: Muslim matrimony / Muslim rishta search for Nikah, with guardian (wali) and family involvement
- How it works: create a profile, browse reviewed profiles with filters, send an interest, contact details unlock after mutual acceptance, families then get involved
- Privacy: contact details are never shown on profile cards; members can report and block
- Registration: currently free
- Audience: Muslim individuals and families in India, and Indian Muslims living abroad
- Languages on the site: English, Arabic, Urdu (language switcher on the home page)
- Support: WhatsApp / phone +91 91894 15356, email support@shaadisunnah.com

## Pages
- [Home](https://shaadisunnah.com/): overview, how it works, safety, FAQ, registration
- [Free Muslim Biodata Maker](https://shaadisunnah.com/biodata.html): create a marriage biodata (PDF) with Bismillah header; runs in the browser and data is not uploaded
- [Careers](https://shaadisunnah.com/career.html): open roles and application form
- [Privacy Policy](https://shaadisunnah.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of Service](https://shaadisunnah.com/terms.html)
